free_tier.stated: A ten-day free trial on every Linux plan, with no automatic conversion to a paid contract, no minimum period, the first month free and no setup fee except on the L0 plan. L0 is 0.5 GB memory with 1 virtual core and 30 GB SSD or 50 GB HDD at JPY 554 a month including tax; L1 is JPY 968; the ladder runs to L7 at 64 GB. The L0 setup fee is JPY 1,130.

retention.stated: The trial is ten days and the L0 plan cannot be reached by downgrading an existing larger plan, so the cheap shape is only available to a new order; after ten days the box either converts at full price or is discarded with its contents.

chaining: This is the Japanese trial that does not convert silently, which makes it the safe half of a pair with Sakura VPS: use ABLENET for a ten-day job you intend to abandon and Sakura for one you intend to keep.

notes: The distinguishing fact against Sakura VPS and XServer VPS is the absence of automatic conversion; the vendor says so in its own copy and a press release repeats it. The card identity cost is inferred from a monthly or hourly billing model, and the signup page is the route that would settle it.
